author: Pallas, 1773
habitat: 낮은 산지의 숲 가장자리, 평지 초원, 강가 버드나무 숲
summary: 우리나라 북부에서는 흔히 번식하는 텃새이고, 중부 이남에서는 불규칙하게 찾아오는 겨울새이다. 낮은 산지의 숲 가장자리와 평지 초원, 강가 버드나무 숲에 살며, 여름에는 암수가 함께 지내다가 겨울에는 흔히 작은 무리를 짓는다. 바닷가나 평지의 관목림, 강가 버드나무 숲에 둥지를 틀고 한배에 알을 3~4개 낳는다. 여름에는 작은 곤충을, 가을과 겨울에는 주로 식물성 먹이를 먹으며, 우수리·만주·한국 북부에서 번식하고 한국 중부 이남과 중국 북부에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: red plumage with white or greyish-white feather edges (male)

sexes.male: 온몸이 붉은빛이고 깃 가장자리는 흰색이나 잿빛 흰색이며, 날개는 검은 갈색이다.
sexes.female: 온몸이 갈색이고 검은 세로 줄무늬가 있다.

art.subject: Siberian Long-tailed Rosefinch (Uragus sibiricus), adult male in winter (November–March): plumage rose-pink to pinkish-red, softened by white or greyish-white feather edges; lores and the area around the bill base deeper crimson; forehead, crown and throat frosted silvery-white; back pink with dark feather centres; rump rosy-red; wings blackish-brown with two broad white wing-bars and white-edged tertials; long tail blackish with white outer feathers; belly pinkish, paler towards the vent; short, stubby, pale horn-coloured bill; dark eye; brownish legs.
art.pose: perched in a riverside willow, side view
art.scene: Korean winter riverside: willow thicket along a river with lowland grassland beyond; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view perched on a willow twig: rose-pink body with whitish feather edges, frosted silvery-white crown and throat, blackish-brown wings with two broad white wing-bars, long blackish tail with white outer feathers, stubby pale bill

adult female, side view perched: greyish-brown to buff-brown plumage with fine dark streaks on the upperparts, breast and flanks, a warm buff wash on the breast and flanks, two white wing-bars, long tail with white outer feathers, stubby pale bill
art.build: Small finch with a disproportionately long tail, 15cm: body about sparrow-sized, the tail nearly as long as the body. Rounded head with no crest; the crown feathers lie flat. Short, deep, stubby conical bill, bullfinch-like and much shorter than the head. Legs short and brownish. Wings short; at rest the wingtips reach only the base of the tail. Tail long and narrow, blackish with broad white outer feathers. Feeds on seeds of weeds and willows, clinging to stems; flight bouncing, showing the white tail sides.
avoid: Do not give it a short tail like Common or Pallas's Rosefinch; the tail is long with white outer feathers.
Do not omit the two broad white wing-bars.
Do not paint a large, dark or pointed bill; it is short, stubby and pale.
Do not paint the female pink; she is brown with black streaks.
